causes.label: The washer is in a cold rinse cycle
remedies: This is normal.
The PerfecTemp feature is designed not to activate during a cold rinse cycle to improve the energy efficiency of your washer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "The washer is in a cold rinse cycle"

symptoms.symptom: (Review PerfecTemp in the “About the control panel” section)

causes.label: All the water in your household water heater has been used
remedies: Wait until the water in the water heater is heated to the correct temperature.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "All the water in your household water heater has been used"

symptoms.symptom: Water fills and drains at the same time

causes.label: Drain stand pipe is too low
remedies: The drain stand pipe must be above 30".
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Drain stand pipe is too low"

causes.label: Too much detergent
remedies: Measure your detergent carefully.
Use less soap if you have soft water, a smaller load or a lightly soiled load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Too much detergent"

causes.label: Type of detergent
remedies: Switch to HE detergent.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Type of detergent"

causes.label: Soft water
remedies: Try less detergent.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Soft water"

causes.label: Using too much detergent in washer
remedies: Use less detergent.
Use less soap if you have soft water, a smaller load or a lightly soiled load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Using too much detergent in washer"

causes.label: Type of detergent
remedies: Switch to HE detergent.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Type of detergent"

causes.label: Fill hoses or drain hose is improperly connected
remedies: Make sure hose connections are tight at faucets and rubber washers are installed.
Make sure end of drain hose is correctly inserted in and secured to drain facility.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Fill hoses or drain hose is improperly connected"

causes.label: Household drain may be clogged
remedies: Check household plumbing.
You may need to call a plumber.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Household drain may be clogged"

causes.label: Constant water pressure to the fill hoses at the water source
remedies: Tighten hoses at the faucets and turn the water off after each use.
Check condition of the fill hoses; they should be replaced every 5 years.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Constant water pressure to the fill hoses at the water source"

causes.label: Cooler water temperatures provide improved energy efficiency
remedies: New laundry detergents have been formulated to work with cooler water temperatures without affecting wash performance.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Cooler water temperatures provide improved energy efficiency"

causes.label: Control is not set properly
remedies: Check water temperature control and adjust.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Control is not set properly"

causes.label: Water supply is turned off or improperly connected
remedies: Turn both hot and cold faucets fully on and make sure hoses are connected to correct faucets.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Water supply is turned off or improperly connected"

causes.label: Water valve screens are stopped up
remedies: Turn off the water source and remove the water connection hoses from the upper back of the washer.
Use a brush or toothpick to clean the screens in the machine.
Reconnect the hoses and turn the water back on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Water valve screens are stopped up"

causes.label: The PREWASH Cycle or AUTO SOAK Option was chosen
remedies: This is normal.
The washer alternates between agitate and soak during these cycles to get your clothes cleaner with less wear.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "The PREWASH Cycle or AUTO SOAK Option was chosen"

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: The washer may pause during the spin cycle to remove soapy water more efficiently.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "This is normal"

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: Water may not cover the top level of the clothes.
This is normal for this high efficiency washer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "This is normal"

symptoms.symptom: Water does not fill when lid is open

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: The lid must be closed for the washer to operate.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "This is normal"

causes.label: Washer is unplugged
remedies: Make sure cord is plugged securely into a working outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Washer is unplugged"

causes.label: Water supply is turned off
remedies: Turn both hot and cold faucets fully on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Water supply is turned off"

causes.label: Controls are not set properly
remedies: Check controls.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Controls are not set properly"

causes.label: Lid is open—safety feature prevents agitation and spinning when lid is up
remedies: Close lid and reset cycle, to the beginning if necessary.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Lid is open—safety feature prevents agitation and spinning when lid is up"

causes.label: Circuit breaker/fuse is tripped/blown
remedies: Check house circuit breakers/fuses.
Replace fuses or reset breaker.
Washer should have a separate outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Circuit breaker/fuse is tripped/blown"

causes.label: Electronics need to be reset
remedies: Unplug washer, wait 2 minutes, plug back in and press START.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Electronics need to be reset"

causes.label: START was not pressed
remedies: Press START.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "START was not pressed"

causes.label: Lid magnet missing
remedies: Call for service.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Lid magnet missing"

causes.label: Unit filling
remedies: This is normal.
Estimated time remaining is updated during fill time.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Unit filling"

causes.label: Incorrect spin cycle selected
remedies: Make sure the spin cycle selected matches the load you are washing.
Some fabrics will feel wetter when rinsed with cold water.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Incorrect spin cycle selected"

causes.label: Incorrect use of fabric softener
remedies: Check fabric softener package for instructions and follow directions for using dispenser.
Make sure you have selected the Fabric Softener option (for Energy Star models).
Pretreat stain and rewash.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Incorrect use of fabric softener"

causes.label: Dye transfer
remedies: Sort whites or lightly colored items from dark colors.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Dye transfer"

causes.label: Detergent amount
remedies: Be sure to follow detergent manufacturer’s directions.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Detergent amount"

causes.label: Hard water
remedies: Use a water conditioner like Calgon brand or install a water softener.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Hard water"

causes.label: Water is not hot enough
remedies: Make sure water heater is delivering water at 120°F–140°F (48°C–60°C).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Water is not hot enough"

causes.label: Washer is overloaded
remedies: Load clothes no higher than the top row of holes in the washer basket.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Washer is overloaded"

causes.label: Detergent is not dissolving
remedies: Add detergent to the wash basket before you load clothes.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Detergent is not dissolving"

causes.label: Dye transfer
remedies: Sort clothes by color.
If fabric label states wash separately, unstable dyes may be indicated.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Dye transfer"

causes.label: Clothes are air or line dried
remedies: If you do not dry your clothes with a clothes dryer, your clothes may retain more lint.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Clothes are air or line dried"

causes.label: Incorrect sorting
remedies: Separate lint producers from lint collectors.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Incorrect sorting"

causes.label: Washing too long
remedies: Wash small loads for a shorter time than larger loads.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Washing too long"

causes.label: Detergent not dissolving
remedies: Add detergent to wash basket before you load clothes.
Try a liquid detergent.
Use warmer water temperature.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Detergent not dissolving"

causes.label: Overloading
remedies: Load clothes no higher than the top row of holes in the washer basket.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Overloading"

causes.label: Incorrect use of fabric softener
remedies: Check fabric softener package for instructions and follow directions for using dispenser.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Incorrect use of fabric softener"

causes.label: Shifter mechanism is engaging or disengaging
remedies: The drive system will engage at the start of agitate and disengage when agitate is complete.
This occurs multiple times during the wash.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Shifter mechanism is engaging or disengaging"

symptoms.symptom: Back and forth “swoosh” or light “clicking” sound during agitate

causes.label: Electric motor reversing direction
remedies: This machine has a drive system that doesn’t use gears.
This sound is the motor rotating back and forth to clean your laundry.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Electric motor reversing direction"

symptoms.symptom: Quick short agitation sounds at end of agitate

causes.label: Clothing redistribution
remedies: At the end of agitate, the motor makes short agitation strokes to redistribute the load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Clothing redistribution"

causes.label: Relay switch
remedies: The relay makes a click sound when activated.
The water level activates the relay and stops filling.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Relay switch"

causes.label: Automatic Temperature Control Valve
remedies: This valve mixes in cold and hot water.
The “clicking” is the valve turning on and off.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Automatic Temperature Control Valve"

causes.label: Automatic Temperature Control Valve
remedies: This valve mixes in cold and hot water.
The sound changes when the valves are turned on and off.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Automatic Temperature Control Valve"

symptoms.symptom: Motor “whining up” or “coasting down” in spin

causes.label: Motor ramping up/down during spin cycle
remedies: The motor will speed up incrementally during the spin cycle.
When spin is complete, it will coast until it stops.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Motor ramping up/down during spin cycle"

causes.label: Water drain pump
remedies: The drain pump will make a humming sound when pumping out water after agitation stops and continue until spin is complete.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Water drain pump"

causes.label: Water drain pump
remedies: When the pump starts drawing in air, It starts to gurgle.
The washer should then begin spinning and the sound will continue until it is done spinning.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Water drain pump"

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: This washer uses a pulsator wash action.
Water swishing while the unit is agitating is normal, especially with smaller loads.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "This is normal"

causes.label: Washer is uneven
remedies: To level the front of the washer, adjust the front leveling legs by rotating the individual leg in the proper direction for up or down.
To level the back of the washer, lift the back of the machine 4" (11 cm) and set down.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Washer is uneven"
